message.content: 60 shares at ~$222.72 would cost ~$13,363, which exceeds the $10,000 per-order cap — so I'll need two orders. First order: 44 shares (~$9,800).
message.reasoning:
Need at least 60 shares. 60 × 222.72 = 13,363.20 — exceeds $10,000 per order cap. So max shares per order = floor(10000/222.72) = 44 shares (44 × 222.72 = 9,799.68). Then top up: need 16 more shares = 3,563.52, within $10,000 and total $13,363.20 < $20,000.

So place first order 44 shares at limit ~222.75 (close to market). Then re-check account, then buy 16 more.

Let me place first order.
